Only after visiting all unique rooms will I issue the "DONE" command.

New plan: I failed because I entered the Solarium without first checking the south direction from the Dining room, which led me to miss the Bedroom and Lobby. Next time, I will strictly follow a systematic path: from the Nursery, go south to the Balcony; immediately from the Balcony, go west to the Dining room; then from the Dining room, go south to the Lobby; then from the Lobby, go east to the Bedroom; finally, go north from the Bedroom to the Dining room (already visited) and then north from the Dining room to the Solarium. Only after visiting all unique rooms will I issue the "DONE" command.
